q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of a tinplate food can?
title: Tinplate can carbon footprint per can
short: Multiply the tinplate per can (body and two ends) by the steel supplier's figure, then add slitting, welding, lacquering and curing energy. Divide the plant's energy by cans made, stated by can size.
audience: Metal can makers for food and paint

ul: Tinplate sheet for body and ends.

p: Report per can by size. The tinplate usually carries most of the footprint.

example.title: Worked example: tinplate can unit per can (one month)
lines: Plant total: 97,800 / 5,000,000 = 0.0196 kg CO2 per can
Add tinplate for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and production records.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
